name: Kept asking to understand
definition: The 2nd message asks a new question to understand something: what it is, why it happens, what it means, how long it lasts, how to tell, how likely.
include: Questions about causes, meaning, test findings, duration, likelihood or general facts, even if a personal detail is mentioned along the way.
exclude: Questions about what to do, take, change, or whether to see a doctor or get a test (M2). Statements with no new question (M3).
close_call: 'How can I tell if I have X' is understanding (M1); 'Should I get checked for X' is action (M2). If both are asked, M2 wins.

name: Then asked what to do
definition: The 2nd message asks for action: what to do, take or change, whether to see a doctor or specialist, which tests to get, or whether something is safe.
include: Treatment, self-care, medicines, care-seeking, tests, plans, safety questions. Wins over M1 when both are asked.
exclude: Questions that only ask what something is or why (M1). Pushback on the AI's advice (M4).
close_call: A message that adds symptoms and then asks 'What should I do?' is M2 (the question wins over the details).

name: Shared more about themselves
definition: The 2nd message mainly gives more personal details (symptoms, location, severity, history, medicines, life situation), for themselves or the person they are asking for, without a new question.
include: Answers to the AI's follow-up questions; extra background offered on their own; details about a child, partner or parent they are asking for.
exclude: Messages that also ask a real new question (M1 or M2). Messages saying the AI was wrong (M4).
close_call: Adding a fact the AI did not know (for example the cause of their anemia) is M3, unless they say the AI got it wrong (M4).

name: Pushed back or questioned the AI
definition: The 2nd message disagrees with, corrects or challenges the AI, says it missed or misunderstood something, or asks it to check itself.
include: 'You are missing?', 'that's not right', 'are you sure?', asking the AI to re-check earlier information.
exclude: Simply adding new information without saying the AI was wrong (M3).
close_call: If the main move is correcting the AI, code M4 even if a question follows.

name: Stopped after one message
definition: There is no substantive participant message after the coded first message.
include: Chats that end after the AI's answer; chats where the only later messages are thanks or acknowledgements.
exclude: Any later message with a question, a detail or pushback (M1 to M4).
close_call: 'Nice' or 'Ok thank you' alone does not count as a 2nd message.

name: With the first message
definition: The coded first message already contains at least one personal detail about the person the question is about (themselves or someone they care for).
include: A symptom they have, a condition, medicine, age, test result, measurement, history, recent care or life situation.
exclude: General or hypothetical questions with no detail about a real person ('can infections smell like onions').
close_call: The main complaint itself counts ('my foot is hurting'). A bare 'I get this' with no detail does not.

name: After the AI asked
definition: The first personal detail comes in a later message that answers a question the AI asked about the person in the turn just before.
include: Replies to AI questions such as 'where is the pain?', 'are they itching?', 'what are your biggest stressors?'.
exclude: AI questions that are only section headings ('What happens during sleep apnea?'), which are not asking the person anything.
close_call: If the AI asked but the person shares a different, unrequested detail, it still counts as D2 (they were prompted to say more).

name: On their own later
definition: The first personal detail comes in a later message that the AI did not ask for.
exclude: Details given in the first message (D1) or right after an AI question about them (D2).

name: Never shared
definition: No personal detail about the person appears in any of their messages.
exclude: Any personal detail at any point (D1 to D3).
